text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a history of a psychiatric condition and new-onset movement disorder; to begin my assessment, how long have you been experiencing these involuntary movements?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old college student. The patient is here for a follow-up appointment. He was recently diagnosed with schizophrenia and started on risperidone approximately 2 months ago. Reports a significant improvement in psychiatric symptoms since the start of treatment.

speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Tardive Dyskinesia secondary to Risperidone use.
